name: Seijo to Konoe to Apple Pie
original_name: 聖女と近衛とアップルパイ
source:
"--You will be slain by the brave man you love."

The future told by the knight who appeared suddenly. The strange journey to avoid the future with knight, mage and minstrel. The secrets of a sacred woman and kingdom intertwine, I'm going to fall in love--

[From Google Play]
translation:
「——你將被自己深愛的勇者所殺。」

突然現身的騎士，道出了這樣的未來。為了避開這個結局，你與騎士、魔法師、吟遊詩人展開了一段奇妙旅程。聖女與王國的秘密彼此交織，而你也即將墜入愛河——

[摘自Google Play]
